title: KIP Registry
description: Gold-standard Key Information Points extracted manually from a single anonymized artifact. Each KIP is an atomic, verifiable, documentation-relevant fact that a wiki entry should capture.

artifact_type.description: Artifact type as defined in the Control Set decisions document.

extracted_by.description: Person who manually extracted the KIPs.

validated_by.description: Domain expert who reviewed the KIPs. Null if not yet validated.

extraction_date.description: ISO 8601 date when extraction was performed.

validation_date.description: ISO 8601 date when domain expert validated. Null if not yet validated.

narrative_summary.description: One-sentence summary of the workstream narrative arc (Step 2 of extraction procedure).

kips.description: List of extracted Key Information Points.

id.description: Sequential identifier scoped to this artifact (KIP-001, KIP-002, ...).

text.description: The atomic fact, stated as a concise declarative sentence.

category.description: KIP category code per the extraction guideline. DEC=Design Decision, IMP=Implementation Action, FIX=Bug Fix/Correction, RAT=Rationale, CFG=Configuration/Infrastructure, DEP=Dependency Change, TEC=Technical Detail.

source_ref.description: Traceable reference to evidence in the artifact. Format: 'commit:<hash>' | 'PR#<number>' | 'WI:AB#<id>' | 'inferred:<hash1>,<hash2>' with justification.

implicit.description: True if the KIP is inferred from a pattern of changes rather than stated explicitly in any single source.
